Great selection and better prices than competitors! My animals all have some kind of specific dietary need and the food that best suits them usually can only be found at PetPantry. Super happy to be supporting a local business.
Helpful staff, fast delivery,  Good Prices.
Great pet food selection! I placed an online order, prices were great and it was shipped quickly. The box was nicely packed. Will order from again, happily!
support your local business! They have all my Jack needs!

Delivery was good and on time. Messaged when did not have exact product.

Amazing! Good deals, great rides and kudos to Sami, excellent delivery!! 🥰 …

They have an amazing selection and awesome customer service. Very happy with them :)

I cannot express how much I appreciate Pet Pantery and their staff. They literally helped save my cat by guiding me to the right food product and litter. Since she started eating N&D, she has recovered from the severe allergies she had been struggling with for many years, which we had only been able to manage temporarily with medication.

Choosing the right litter also helped, she no longer has issues with powdery dust sticking to her fur. Some lightweight litters used to cling to her fur because of static electricity, but this problem is now gone.

I also truly appreciate all of their other services. Their shampoo and other products are excellent, and their on-time delivery service is wonderful.

We and our cats love you all! 🫶💕🐈‍⬛🐈💕

I was expecting my order on Monday and I was not informed that there was a delay of one of the items in ordering and I had to follow up.  I would have appreciated a call telling me this.  Order with traded item was received on Tuesday.  Otherwise great service.
Great service and always friendly with suggestions ❤️
When the box arrived with Dr. Marty cat food my cat was all over it. I opened the box and removed the contents. My cat spent at least 30 minutes digging in the empty box trying to find his food.

Fast and efficient delivery.
Great choice of pet food and supplies
They have cat food I can't get anywhere else (at least at those prices) and their delivery is excellent.

Speedy delivery and good selection of products. Love supporting my local pet store!
Excellent service and the addition of some lovely goodies  on my first order was a nice surprise! Good job Pet Pantry. :)
Great delivery service.  There is a charge for it, but I appreciate not having to lug around several large bags of cat litter!
Thank u for amazing customer service gokce

Love the store.  They have a wide selection of food and products for cats (and dogs as well).  Staff are very helpful, friendly, and knowledgeable.
My fur-baby Marma stamped 🐾 with appurroval. …
Love Pet Pantry! Cara at Commercial Drive is absolutely wonderful as well. We are loyal customers!

This my 2nd online order from Pet Pantry. I got the orders delivered the next day, which was faster than I expected. My cat loves Primal frozen nuggets, I’m glad their delivery car/van is equipped to deliver frozen pet food. The nuggets arrived perfectly frozen, in a cardboard box with 2 ice packs… I will surely be making more orders soon.
Ps. Brando would like to thank the Pet Pantry team 😽
Beautiful shop with knowledgeable staff. The carry value items. Only the best for your pet

I've made several orders with Pet Pantry and have always been happy with the quality of their delivery service and product offerings for our cats. Also appreciative of the regular promotions (especially on FirstMate) as well and can't recommend them highly enough!
High prices but quality products. Excellent delivery service.
It's my first choice for a weekend breakfast.  Great value for your $$.
I cannot thank you enough for all the help you gave me and my friend. The treats arrived on time and brought an immense joy to my friend and her lovely dog.
The cashier was very nice and helpful. I found many great toys for my cats for a good price.

I love Pet Pantry! Have ordered from them many times. The online ordering plus free local delivery a wonderful service. Prices are good and they have occasional sales - you can stock up AND have a big enough order to get the free delivery! :-)  If there are any questions about the order, they call to check in, always helpful. Quick and easy, definitely recommend.

I have been using Pet Pantry for few years now.  5 star delivery service.  My order is always complete if not they will call me to see what other alternative they can arrange which I really appreciate.  Highly recommended.
Lovely little pet food store on Davie. Staff are super nice and, despite the size, it has everything I can find at the bigger places.

Great neighborhood pet store, reliable local delivery of big bags of dog food that are hard to walk back home with. Staff are always friendly and helpful. My dog knows when we're within a block of the store and pulls towards it so she gives 5 stars too!
The only place that has my babies' favourite food on sale :).  I only wish it came on sale more than once a year!  Ordering and delivery are easy.
Very happy to find a local pet shop with delivery! My bag of kibble arrived smoothly and I will be setting up a regular delivery. Thank you!
They have the best cat grass which I buy regularly as my cat loves it! My cat is picky about her food and thankfully they have the kind she likes and also smaller cans, life saver!
Great products, staff very helpful and every time I shop I get free samples for my kitties!
Love using pet pantry! Super friendly and efficient store for all your pet needs. A few items we wish they carried like the litter locker refills but overall great!
Couldn't find what I was looking for but found an alternative.  Staff was helpful.
Excellent service and products.
Lovely service!

It can be hard trying to shop local and making the switch from places like PetSmart, but Pet Pantry has a really good range of products and at a similar price point. It's one of the few places I can get Weruva Wx (that isn't ridiculously expensive) and I love their free shipping (local area only). They're alos rolling out a new program to help fund local animal shelters which is pretty cool.

good service good staff

Super experience.  Delivery came early!

I made an order at 11am and Pet Pantry gave my an early surprise and arrived at 2:30pm! Delivery driver was courteous and polite. Def would recommend.
